analysis.label: Company & Economy Analysis
analysis.framing: The listener is a CIM-level advisor rebuilding his technical analysis craft, not to trade but to argue from evidence and show that the financial plan is what matters. Always land the lesson on the evidence-based view: what the technique reveals, and what it cannot. His own order when looking at a company is analysis, then technicals, then company against sector. Never name a fund unless the fund is the category. He uses Thomson ONE at work; reference where a data point lives when it helps.

communication.label: Communication
communication.framing: The listener is an advisor who positions the client as the hero and himself as the guide, produces videos and LinkedIn content, and sits on two nonprofit boards. He is building a communication trainer tool, so each lesson should end with one concrete drill he can run in under ten minutes, written so it could be scored: what to do, and what good looks like. Draw on evidence and named practitioners rather than platitudes.
